{{TagLine|N600 Dual-Band WiFi Router}} :{{ProductPage|https://www.linksys.com/us/p/P-E2500/}} {{SupportPage|vendor=Linksys|model=E2500v4|pid=01t80000003KZuNAAW}} "EWW302-A1-BL-015" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. All of the following devices are internally identical: * [[Linksys E5400]] - ''AC1200 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' * [[Linksys E5350]] - ''AC1000 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' * [[Linksys E5300]] - ''AC750 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' * [[Linksys E2500 v4]] - ''N600 Dual-Band WiFi Router'' {{WiFiCert|WFA81720|01/25/2019}} :Despite being advertised as an N600 device, the hardware is capable of AC1200 :speeds and the WiFi Certification includes 802.11ac. It is not known at this time :whether the device will actually be artificially limited by software. ===See also=== * [https://www.linksys.com/us/support-article?articleNum=316209 ''Getting to know the Linksys E2500 N600 Dual-Band WiFi 4 Router'']
